title: Successful Transitions and Reintegration Tools for Veterans (START-VETS)
official: Development of a Psycho-social Transition Program and Transition Assessment Tools for Veterans With Mental Illness and/or Substance Use Disorders Leaving Prison
summary: This study will develop prison reentry materials for Veterans leaving prison.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Veteran with mental illness and/or substance use disorder released from prison within the past 36 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Psychosis or cognitive impairment precluding active participation
sponsor: VA Office of Research and Development

sites.f: VA North Texas Health Care System Dallas VA Medical Center, Dallas, TX
